title: Energizing Floral Ethiopian Tagine
description: This Ethiopian-inspired dish combines the energizing properties of green chili and lacquer glaze with the comforting flavors of traditional tamasic ingredients. Serve with injera bread for a satisfying meal.

ingredients.name: Lacquer glaze
ingredients.notes: available at Asian markets or online

instructions: Heat oil in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat.
Add chopped onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add minced garlic and grated ginger and cook for 1 minute.
Add shredded cabbage and cook until wilted, about 5 minutes.
Add green chili peppers, turmeric, cumin, paprika, and salt (if using). Stir to combine.
Add lacquer glaze and stir to combine.
Bring to a boil, then reduce heat to low and simmer, covered, for 20 minutes.
Serve over injera bread, garnished with chopped fresh cilantro (optional).
